prompt: What is the on-time performance percentage for each unique airline carrier? Round the percentage to 2 decimal places.
gold_query: SELECT UniqueCarrier, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN ArrDelayMinutes <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)), 2) as on_time_percentage FROM Airline.On_Time_On_Time_Performance_2016_1 WHERE DepTime IS NOT NULL AND ArrTime IS NOT NULL AND Cancelled = 0 AND Diverted = 0 AND (WeatherDelay IS NULL OR WeatherDelay = 0) GROUP BY UniqueCarrier
submitted_query:
SELECT f.UniqueCarrier AS Carrier,
       c.Description AS CarrierName,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.ArrDelayMinutes <= 15 AND f.ArrDelayMinutes IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS OnTimePerformancePct
FROM Airline.On_Time_On_Time_Performance_2016_1 f
LEFT JOIN Airline.L_UNIQUE_CARRIERS c ON f.UniqueCarrier = c.Code
WHERE f.Cancelled = 0
  AND (f.WeatherDelay IS NULL OR f.WeatherDelay = 0)
GROUP BY f.UniqueCarrier, c.Description
ORDER BY f.UniqueCarrier

prompt: Find the top 25 members (member_no, first name, last name, and net_charge_volume) by net charge volume, where refunds (charge_code 'RF') are subtracted from gross charges.
gold_query: SELECT m.member_no, m.firstname, m.lastname, SUM(CASE WHEN c.charge_code = 'RF' THEN -c.charge_amt ELSE c.charge_amt END) as net_charge_volume FROM Credit.member m JOIN Credit.charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt != 0.01 GROUP BY m.member_no, m.firstname, m.lastname ORDER BY net_charge_volume DESC LIMIT 25
submitted_query:
SELECT m.member_no, m.firstname, m.lastname,
       SUM(CASE WHEN c.charge_code = 'RF' THEN -c.charge_amt ELSE c.charge_amt END) AS net_charge_volume
FROM Credit.member m
JOIN Credit.charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no
GROUP BY m.member_no, m.firstname, m.lastname
ORDER BY net_charge_volume DESC
LIMIT 25

prompt: Find the top 30 F1 drivers (first name and last name) by race completion rate, only including drivers with at least 50 race starts. Include total races, completed races, and completion rate.
gold_query: SELECT d.forename, d.surname, COUNT(*) as total_races, SUM(CASE WHEN r.position IS NOT NULL AND r.position > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed_races, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN r.position IS NOT NULL AND r.position > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) as completion_rate FROM ErgastF1.results r JOIN ErgastF1.drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50 ORDER BY completion_rate DESC LIMIT 30
submitted_query:
SELECT d.forename AS first_name,
       d.surname AS last_name,
       COUNT(*) AS total_races,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.statusId = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_races,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.statusId = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / COUNT(*) AS completion_rate
FROM ErgastF1.results r
JOIN ErgastF1.drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY completion_rate DESC
LIMIT 30

prompt: Find the top 50 players by career batting average, only including players with at least 500 career at-bats.
gold_query: SELECT p.nameFirst, p.nameLast, CAST(SUM(b.H) AS REAL) / SUM(b.AB) as career_ba FROM lahman_2014.batting b JOIN lahman_2014.players p ON b.playerID = p.playerID WHERE b.AB >= 100 GROUP BY p.playerID, p.nameFirst, p.nameLast HAVING SUM(b.AB) >= 500 ORDER BY career_ba DESC LIMIT 50
submitted_query:
SELECT p.playerID, p.nameFirst, p.nameLast, SUM(b.H) AS career_hits, SUM(b.AB) AS career_AB, SUM(b.H)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(b.AB),0) AS career_BA
FROM lahman_2014.players p
JOIN lahman_2014.batting b ON p.playerID = b.playerID
GROUP BY p.playerID, p.nameFirst, p.nameLast
HAVING SUM(b.AB) >= 500
ORDER BY career_BA DESC
LIMIT 50

prompt: Find the top 30 F1 drivers by podium finishes.

submitted_query:

prompt: For beers missing IBU data, impute a value of 20 (typical for lagers/wheat beers) and calculate average IBU by style.
gold_query: SELECT b.style, AVG(COALESCE(b.ibu, 20)) as avg_ibu_imputed FROM CraftBeer.beers b GROUP BY b.style
submitted_query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN style LIKE '%IPA%' OR style LIKE '%India Pale Ale%' THEN 'IPA'
    WHEN style LIKE '%Stout%' OR style LIKE '%Porter%' THEN 'Stout/Porter'
    WHEN style LIKE '%Lager%' OR style LIKE '%Pilsner%' OR style LIKE '%Pilsener%' THEN 'Lager/Pilsner'
    WHEN style LIKE '%Hefeweizen%' OR style LIKE '%Witbier%' OR style LIKE '%Wheat%' THEN 'Wheat'

prompt: Calculate win rates for White players (with at least 5 games). Return the 30 players with the highest win rates, ordered by win rate descending.
gold_query: SELECT g.white as player, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN g.game_result = '1-0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) as win_rate FROM Chess.game g JOIN Chess.opening o ON g.opening_id = o.opening_id WHERE o.name NOT LIKE '%French%' AND o.name NOT LIKE '%Sicilian%' GROUP BY g.white HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY win_rate DESC LIMIT 30
submitted_query:
SELECT g.white,
       COUNT(*) AS total_games,
       SUM(CASE WHEN g.game_result = '1-0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins,
       SUM(CASE WHEN g.game_result = '1-0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / COUNT(*) AS win_rate
FROM Chess.game g
JOIN Chess.opening o ON g.opening_id = o.opening_id
WHERE NOT (o.name LIKE '%French%' OR g.opening LIKE '%French%')
  AND NOT (o.name LIKE '%Sicilian%' OR g.opening LIKE '%Sicilian%')
GROUP BY g.white
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY win_rate DESC
LIMIT 30;

prompt: Calculate the current headcount by department based on their current department assignment, counting each employee only once based on their most recent department assignment. Be sure to return departments by name, not id.
gold_query: SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(DISTINCT de.emp_no) as headcount FROM employee.dept_emp de JOIN employee.departments d ON de.dept_no = d.dept_no WHERE de.to_date = '9999-01-01' AND de.emp_no NOT IN (SELECT emp_no FROM employee.dept_manager WHERE to_date = '9999-01-01') GROUP BY d.dept_name
submitted_query:
WITH latest_dept AS (
  SELECT de.emp_no, de.dept_no,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY de.emp_no ORDER BY de.from_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM employee.dept_emp de
  WHERE de.to_date = '9999-01-01'
)
SELECT d.dept_name,
       COUNT(*) AS headcount
FROM latest_dept ld
JOIN employee.departments d ON ld.dept_no = d.dept_no
JOIN employee.employees e ON ld.emp_no = e.emp_no
WHERE ld.rn = 1
  AND e.emp_no NOT IN (
    SELECT emp_no FROM employee.dept_manager WHERE to_date = '9999-01-01'
  )
GROUP BY d.dept_name
ORDER BY d.dept_name;

prompt: Find the top 50 member-quarters by charge count. I want to see the member's first and last name, the statement number, the charge count, and the total charges.
gold_query: SELECT m.firstname, m.lastname, c.statement_no, COUNT(*) as charge_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) as total_charges FROM Credit.member m JOIN Credit.charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no WHERE c.charge_amt != 0.01 AND c.charge_code != 'RF' GROUP BY m.member_no, m.firstname, m.lastname, c.statement_no ORDER BY charge_count DESC LIMIT 50
submitted_query:
SELECT m.firstname,
       m.lastname,
       MIN(s.statement_no) AS statement_no,
       DATE_TRUNC('quarter', s.statement_dt) AS quarter_start,
       COUNT(c.charge_no) AS charge_count,
       SUM(c.charge_amt) AS total_charges
FROM Credit.member m
JOIN Credit.charge c ON m.member_no = c.member_no
JOIN Credit.statement s ON c.statement_no = s.statement_no
WHERE c.charge_code != 'RF'
  AND c.charge_amt >= 5.0
  AND c.charge_amt != 0.01
GROUP BY m.member_no, m.firstname, m.lastname, quarter_start
ORDER BY charge_count DESC
LIMIT 50

prompt: Identify games with rating mismatches (Elo difference > 400 points) that should be weighted 0.5x in opening analysis.
gold_query: SELECT g.game_id, g.white, g.black, g.whiteElo, g.BlackElo, ABS(g.whiteElo - g.BlackElo) as elo_diff, o.name as opening FROM Chess.game g JOIN Chess.opening o ON g.opening_id = o.opening_id WHERE g.whiteElo IS NOT NULL AND g.BlackElo IS NOT NULL AND ABS(g.whiteElo - g.BlackElo) > 400 AND o.name NOT LIKE '%French%' AND o.name NOT LIKE '%Sicilian%'
submitted_query:
SELECT g.game_id,
       o.name AS opening_name,
       g.white,
       g.black,
       g.whiteElo,
       g.BlackElo,
       ABS(g.whiteElo - g.BlackElo) AS rating_diff,
       0.5 AS weight
FROM Chess.game g
JOIN Chess.opening o ON g.opening_id = o.opening_id
WHERE ABS(g.whiteElo - g.BlackElo) > 400
  AND g.whiteElo IS NOT NULL AND g.BlackElo IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT (o.name LIKE '%French%' OR g.opening LIKE '%French%')
  AND NOT (o.name LIKE '%Sicilian%' OR g.opening LIKE '%Sicilian%');

prompt: Group charges by spending type. Show the spending_type, charge_count, and total_amount.
gold_query: SELECT CASE WHEN c.category_no BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN 'Essential' WHEN c.category_no BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN 'Discretionary' ELSE 'Other' END as spending_type, COUNT(*) as charge_count, SUM(c.charge_amt) as total_amount FROM Credit.charge c WHERE c.charge_amt != 0.01 AND c.charge_code != 'RF' GROUP BY CASE WHEN c.category_no BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN 'Essential' WHEN c.category_no BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN 'Discretionary' ELSE 'Other' END
submitted_query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN c.category_no BETWEEN 1 AND 10 THEN 'essential'
    WHEN c.category_no BETWEEN 11 AND 20 THEN 'discretionary'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS spending_type,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.charge_code != 'RF') AS charge_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.charge_code = 'RF' THEN -c.charge_amt ELSE c.charge_amt END) AS total_amount
FROM Credit.charge c
WHERE c.charge_amt >= 5.0
  AND c.charge_amt != 0.01
GROUP BY spending_type
ORDER BY spending_type

prompt: Find salary statistics for departments where salary statistics can be reported. Show me employee count and average salary by department name.
gold_query: SELECT d.dept_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_no) as employee_count, AVG(s.salary) as avg_salary FROM employee.dept_emp de JOIN employee.departments d ON de.dept_no = d.dept_no JOIN employee.employees e ON de.emp_no = e.emp_no JOIN employee.salaries s ON e.emp_no = s.emp_no WHERE de.to_date = '9999-01-01' AND s.to_date = '9999-01-01' GROUP BY d.dept_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_no) >= 5
submitted_query:
WITH cur_dept AS (
 SELECT de.emp_no, de.dept_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY de.emp_no ORDER BY de.from_date DESC) AS rn
 FROM employee.dept_emp de
 WHERE de.to_date = '9999-01-01'
),
cur_sal AS (
 SELECT s.emp_no, s.salary
 FROM employee.salaries s
 WHERE s.to_date = '9999-01-01'
),
cur_mgr AS (
 SELECT dm.emp_no
 FROM employee.dept_manager dm
 WHERE dm.to_date = '9999-01-01'
)
SELECT d.dept_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cd.emp_no) AS employee_count,
       AVG(cs.salary) AS avg_salary
FROM cur_dept cd
JOIN employee.departments d ON cd.dept_no = d.dept_no
JOIN cur_sal cs ON cd.emp_no = cs.emp_no
WHERE cd.rn = 1
  AND cd.emp_no NOT IN (SELECT emp_no FROM cur_mgr)

prompt: Show carrier performance with counts of on-time, moderately delayed, and severely delayed flights.
gold_query: SELECT UniqueCarrier, SUM(CASE WHEN ArrDelayMinutes <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as on_time, SUM(CASE WHEN ArrDelayMinutes > 15 AND ArrDelayMinutes <= 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as moderate_delays, SUM(CASE WHEN ArrDelayMinutes > 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as severe_delays FROM Airline.On_Time_On_Time_Performance_2016_1 WHERE DepTime IS NOT NULL AND ArrTime IS NOT NULL AND Cancelled = 0 AND (WeatherDelay IS NULL OR WeatherDelay = 0) GROUP BY UniqueCarrier
submitted_query:
SELECT f.UniqueCarrier,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN f.ArrDelayMinutes <= 15 THEN 1 END) AS on_time_cnt,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN f.ArrDelayMinutes > 15 AND f.ArrDelayMinutes < 180 THEN 1 END) AS moderate_cnt,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN f.ArrDelayMinutes >= 180 THEN 1 END) AS severe_cnt
FROM Airline.On_Time_On_Time_Performance_2016_1 f
WHERE f.Cancelled = 0
  AND f.DepTime IS NOT NULL AND f.ArrTime IS NOT NULL
  AND (f.WeatherDelay IS NULL OR f.WeatherDelay = 0)
GROUP BY f.UniqueCarrier
ORDER BY f.UniqueCarrier
